source.manual: External MANUAL-TESTING.md (not stored in this checkout)
source.scope: Sections 1-20 contain the 154 behavioral checks. Section 0 is an environment matrix and is intentionally recorded here as context rather than duplicate inventory items.
environmentMatrix: GitHub release unpackaged build on Windows 11
Copilot+ PC (NPU) required for WinAI capture

classificationNotes.existing unit test: Existing Tests coverage verifies the deterministic logic named in currentCoverage; it does not claim the manual UI surface is automated.
classificationNotes.winapp UIA: Deterministic UI Automation coverage using stable automation contracts; a contract-level mapping records when a scenario is not fully driven.
classificationNotes.real-input automation: Unlocked-desktop coverage with physical input, focus, tray, hotkey, drag/drop, or clipboard behavior; capability-gated mappings skip safely when unavailable.
classificationNotes.fixture-assisted automation: Planned coverage against deterministic external images or a fixture host.
classificationNotes.packaged/VM lane: Planned disposable-user or resettable-VM coverage for installation and shell integration.
classificationNotes.hardware/display lane: Planned capability-labelled machine coverage for display, OCR engine, language pack, or hardware-specific behavior.
classificationNotes.manual-only: Requires a subjective human observation, such as visual artwork or audible speech quality.
